Field Test Companion works alongside existing colour-change drug-test kits. The officer photographs the reacted test on the reference colour card; the app corrects the colours using the card and reads the reaction colour.
Its output is a presumptive field result. It never replaces laboratory confirmation.
Everything runs on this phone. Photos are never uploaded. No server, no account.
Print in colour on A4 at 100% (no fit-to-page), check the 50 mm scale bar with a ruler, cut on the crop marks, and register each copy before use.
